the impact of pharmacy deregulation is mixed, with positive effects for some outcomes (e.g., accessibility of medicines, availability of pharmacy services, costs) and negative effects for other outcomes (e.g. quality of services).

the results of this review are mixed and that the effects of deregulation in community pharmacies vary across European countries and that the evidence base on the effects of deregulated pharmacy markets is limited.

there is a clear need for a more comprehensive approach to the study of the impact of deregulation in the pharmacy sector.
the impact of pharmacy deregulation on the availability of medicines and pharmacy services depends on the specific policy design, and that there is no one-size-fits-all approach.
